p:cNvPr.descr: Aminoacylation of tRNA by aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases. This begins with a blue box labeled as amino acid. It begins with C, which bonds up to H, left to R, down to H3N (plus sign over N), and right to C, which double bonds down to O and right to O-. This is added to ATP, where P bonds left to –O, double bonds up to O, bonds down to O- and right to O, which bonds right to P, which double bonds up to O, bonds down to O-, and right to O bonds right to P. This bonds line has a red arrow pointing back to O. Also, a red line points from the amino acid box to this P. P also double bonds up to O, bonds down to O- and right to O, which bonds right to CH2. CH2 bonds down to H as the left point of a pentagon. The top point is O. At the right point, Adenine in a box bonds down to H. At the bottom right and bottom left points, H (inside) bonds down to OH. An arrow points down as step 1: Carboxyl of amino acid attacks alpha phosphorus of ATP, forming 5’-aminoacyl adenylate. The down arrow has another arrow jutting from ATP down and right to PPi. This points down to a replica of the blue amino acid box on the left, where the right O bonds right to P, which double bonds up to O, bonds down to O-, and right to O which bonds right to CH2, which bonds down to H as the left point of the same pentagon described above. This is labeled as 5’-aminoacyl adenylate (aminoacyl-AMP). Below this are two diagonal lines pointing out. The left is labeled as class I aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases in blue. This points to a molecular structure that has a sideways version of the same pentagon described above. The former left point, now bottom point, bonds down to O, which bonds down to P, which double bonds right to O, bonds left to –O, and down to O, which sits atop the tRNA image. At the bottom right of this pentagon is 3’, and the top right point is 3’. This portion has a bracket above labeled as 3’ end of tRNA. This bracket extends down to just before a tRNA image. To the right is a blue box labeled as aminoacyl-AMP, where C bonds left to R, up to H, down to H3N+, and right to C. The OH at top left point of the pentagon on the left has two red dots above with a red arrow pointing to this C. C also double bonds down to and right to O. This right bond line has an arrow pointing from it to the O. O bonds right to P (no longer in the blue box), which double bonds up to O, bonds down to O-, and right to O, which bonds right to adenosine in a box. Back up at the top and to the right, the diagonal arrow is labeled as class II aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases in blue. It points to the same exact molecular structure as below the diagonal arrow pointing left, but the two dots and arrow are above the O in OH at the bottom right point. The tRNA structure has a down arrow below, which has an arrow jutting left to AMP. This is step 2a: Aminoacyl group is transferred to the 2’—OH of the 3’-terminal A residue of tRNA, releasing AMP. From the right tRNA is also a down arrow with an arrow jutting left to AMP. This is step 2b: Aminoacyl group is transferred directly to the 3’—OH of the 3’-terminal A residue of tRNA, generating the aminoacyl-tRNA product. The left down arrow points to a replica of the previous image, but the top right point of the pentagon has H (inside) pointing to O instead of OH. This O bonds right to C. A red arrow points from this bond line back to O. C double bonds down to O. The O in the OH on the bottom right point of the pentagon has two red dots above with an arrow pointing to this double-bond line. C also bonds right to C, which bonds up to H, right to R, and down to +NH3. From C to NH3+ is all in a blue box. To the right of this is an arrow labeled as transesterification. This is step 3a: Transesterification moves the aminoacyl group to the 3’—OH of the same tRNA residue, generating the aminoacyl-tRNA product. This arrow points right to a replica of the molecular structure on the left, but the top right point of the pentagon has H bonding right to OH, and the bottom right has H bonding to O, which bonds right to the same structure in the blue box as on the left side. This is labeled as aminoacyl-tRNA.
